mapper.sql: task_id, project_id, running, file_path, offset, file_size, last_read_at, lines_read, errors_detected, rule_matched, agent_triggered, degraded
mapper.select: SELECT FROM log_monitor_task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY last_read_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_monitor_task (task_id, project_id, running, file_path, offset, file_size, lines_read, errors_detected, rule_matched, agent_triggered , degraded) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{projectId}, #{running}, #{filePath}, #{offset}, #{fileSize}, #{linesRead}, #{errorsDetected}, #{ruleMatched}, #{agentTriggered} , #{degraded})
mapper.update: UPDATE log_monitor_task SET running = #{running}, offset = #{offset}, file_size = #{fileSize}, last_read_at = #{lastReadAt}, lines_read = #{linesRead}, errors_detected = #{errorsDetected}, rule_matched = #{ruleMatched}, agent_triggered = #{agentTriggered}, degraded = #{degraded} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
